title: Add POST /items
requirement:
api.handle(method, path) serves GET /items/<id>. Add an optional body argument: handle(method, path, body=None).
POST /items with body {'name': ...} creates an item with the next integer id and returns
(201, {'id': id, 'name': name}); a missing or blank name returns (400, {'error': 'name required'}).
The created item is then readable with GET /items/<id>.
